name: Morpeth 10K & Juniors
course: Town-centre closed roads with a course water station at 5km.
transport: Bridge Street, Oldgate and New Market closures begin 06:00; County Hall parking is about a mile from village.
facilities: Bag drop, village toilets and chip timing; packs collected on day.
rules: 10K minimum age 15; plan for the 90-minute closure limit.
reason: Early road closures can catch drivers before a 09:00 start. The County Hall park-and-jog option and 90-minute cutoff are useful planning facts.

name: Lee Valley VeloPark June Running Festival
distance: Half marathon / 10 miles / 10km / 5km / mile / junior mile
course: Smooth, undulating one-mile circuit with chip-timed lap splits.
transport: About 20 minutes' walk from Stratford or Stratford International; no Swimming Centre car-park access.
facilities: Bag drop, indoor village toilets, water each lap and café.
rules: No pacers. Collect packs from village after 08:00 with confirmation and ID.
reason: One-mile lap splits make pacing easy to review, while the lack of pacers and 20-minute station walk shape race-day plans.

name: Chase the Sun Victoria Park July
start: Weekday evening; confirm distance-specific start waves in final guide.
course: Flat park paths with repeated laps; 10-mile option available alongside 5K and 10K.
transport: Use nearby East London rail and Tube links; plan after-work arrival and park gate access.
facilities: Chip timing, event village and on-course support.
rules: Confirm the evening cutoff for the 10-mile distance before entering.
reason: The midweek 10-mile option is unusual among summer park races. Evening travel and cutoff details deserve checking before booking.

name: Women's Run Series Manchester
course: 2.5km loop crossing Millennium Bridge past Imperial War Museum North and the studios.
transport: MediaCity Metrolink stop is under 100m from event village.
facilities: Changing area, portable toilets, bag drop and water at 5km.
rules: Participants have exclusive start/finish access; supporters use separate spectator zones. Collect pack on day with confirmation and ID.
reason: The short loop and nearby tram stop simplify logistics. Supporters should plan for the designated zones rather than meeting at the finish line.

name: Women's Run Series Battersea
course: Flat park laps: 5K two, 10K four, half 8.75.
transport: Rail and Tube recommended; park parking is paid.
facilities: Informal bag drop, toilets and water every lap; village opens 09:30.
rules: Half pack collection 09:00–10:00; 5K and 10K 09:45–10:45. Source body retains 2026 wording, but date field states 2027.
reason: The half's nearly nine laps offer regular support but demand lap awareness. July heat and a 10:30 start make hydration important.
